rules.where: core.where unwraps constexpr branches; semantic.where uses normal binary operand checking, retaining weak scalar status. Same-kind scalar operands keep the tensor dtype and must fit that dtype.
rules.unsigned: A negative weak scalar with an unsigned tensor is rejected. In-range scalar subtraction uses the unsigned tensor width.
rules.full: semantic.full calls make_scalar(value, dtype), then splat. Existing DSL full constructors currently lose signed-width metadata; this separate limitation is retained in fp4_114-known-full-width-limit.json.

scope: Read-only upstream compiler evidence. No installed Triton compiler or GPU comparison.
